description: listMySshKeys: List the SSH keys stored on your account, with their ids and SHA256 fingerprints. Use this to check whether a key is already stored and to get the ids to pass to orderVps or buildVpsInstance. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: listMySshKeys
